title: Yes Bank Paisabazaar PaisaSave credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: The YES Bank Paisabazaar PaisaSave credit card is a co‑created cashback card that delivers up to 6% cashback on dining and travel spends plus 1% on all other transactions, with no joining fee and easy annual fee waiver.

items.title: Discover Reward Points Redemption Options
items.subtitle: To explore the full range of redemption options for this card, download the SaveSage Club app now.
